title: Discontinuous Prior-Mode Sections and the Geometry of Ambiguity in Intrinsic Image Decomposition
summary: The viral 2015 photograph known as "The Dress" divides observers into two camps because it is ambiguous: the same image colors can be explained either as a blue-black surface under one illuminant or as a white-gold surface under another. We propose a geometric account in which the ambiguity arises from a singularity in intrinsic image decomposition, the inverse problem of separating an observed image into reflectance and illumination.
